title: Building towers that stand
examples: Teacher, why should my tower have a wide bottom?
What shape makes a tower the strongest?
If I make my tower skinny, what happens?

explain.say: Today you will learn to build towers that stay up.
A wide base helps your tower stay steady.
Next, think about keeping your tower level and balanced.
Triangles are strong shapes. They help your tower stay firm.
Use these ideas together. Start wide, build up, and check it is straight.

items: Step 1: Start with a wide base
Step 3: Check that it stays balanced

explain.say: In real life, builders use triangles to make bridges and towers strong.

faq.q: Why is a wide base better than a small base?
faq.a: A wide base gives your tower more room to stand without tipping over. It spreads the weight out so it feels safe.
asks: Why does a wide tower stand better?
What is the best bottom for a tower?

faq.a: Balance means the weight is spread evenly. If one side is much heavier, the tower can tip.
asks: How do I keep my tower level?

faq.q: Are all shapes strong for towers?
faq.a: Triangles are the strongest simple shape. A square can be pushed out of shape, but a triangle keeps its shape.
asks: Can I use circles for my tower?

faq.q: Do I need a wide base even if I build it low?
faq.a: Yes. Even small towers need a base that is wider than the top. This keeps them steady.
asks: Does the base size change with height?

faq.q: What is the most important thing to remember?
faq.a: The most important thing is to always think about the bottom first. A strong bottom helps everything else stay up.
asks: What should I think about first?
What is the secret to tall towers?

facts: A wider base makes a structure harder to tip over.
Triangles are very strong shapes because they distribute force well.
A tower balances best when its weight is spread evenly.
The base should always be wider than the top layer.

quiz.say: Kofi builds a tall tower on a very small base. What will most likely happen?
quiz.why: A small base gives the tower little support, so it tips easily.

wrong.1: The blocks weigh the same, whatever the base.
wrong.2: A small base is easy to wobble, so the tower may fall.

quiz.say: Which shape makes a tower strongest?
quiz.why: A triangle keeps its shape when you push on it.

wrong.0: A square can be pushed out of shape.
wrong.1: A circle rolls, so it is hard to build with.

options.show: put heavy blocks at the top
options.say: put heavy blocks at the top

quiz.why: Even weight keeps the tower from leaning to one side.

wrong.0: A big top makes the tower heavy at the top, so it can tip.
wrong.2: Heavy blocks work best at the bottom.
